name: kart-circuit

scripts.build: if [ -n "$CHUGGIE_PREBUILT_ROM" ] && [ -f "$npm_package_name.gba" ]; then echo "using the prebuilt $npm_package_name.gba"; else python3 ../../scripts/stamp_build.py . && tish build src/main.tish --target gba -o "$npm_package_name.gba"; fi

description: A Mode 7 kart racer on a real Mode 7 ground plane: drift, boost pads, off-road penalties and three rubber-banded AI opponents around a generated circuit.
